_comment: The author's working setup (docs/reference-lab/README.md): two consumer boxes, one model, both with a RAM conversation cache. Addresses are placeholders.

servers.name: lame
servers.note: The faster server (about 70 tokens/s, long context). It keeps idle conversations in RAM, so two subagents can take turns on it cheaply

servers.name: ampere
servers.note: A little slower (about 55 tokens/s). It also keeps idle conversations in RAM (about three of 32K), so two subagents can take turns on it too
